newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds stand still on U.S. market closure.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds stand still on U.S. market closure.

text.p: Argentina's bond market stood still Monday as players stayed away because of the closure of U.S. markets for the President's Day holiday.
"There was zero movement this session," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Not a single trade in the locally traded dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was recorded on screens. That bond was unchanged at 126.50 on Friday.
Argentina's FRB due 2005, which is traded abroad, was 1/4 lower at 91-1/2.
